name: app-grocery-app-with-category-images-and-lime-stepper
title: Supermarket app on pale green: photo category grid, offer cards and lime quantity stepper
whatItIs: Two white phones on pale green. The first has a header with a badge, search field, categories as round-cornered product photos (Meat, Fish, Alcohol, Fruits) and offer cards with dark discount tags; the second is a Beauty listing with chips and product cards where a lime stepper replaces the plus button.
whatItMeans: Clear and fresh; real product photography and a single lime action colour make shopping easy.
techniques: Use real product cutouts for categories.
Put discounts in small dark tags.
Turn add buttons into lime steppers.

vocabulary.definition: A product image acting as category icon.
A quantity control filled with lime.
